C0921.title: Major Shanghai Insurance Commission Fraud Case Exposes Insurance-Surrender Black Market
C0921.summary: In April 2021, Legal Daily and other media reported a Shanghai insurance commission fraud case involving nearly 10 million yuan. Yu Tian, Chen Lan, and others organized group members to act as sham policyholders, provide identity information, bank cards, and funds to buy high-value insurance, and then use collective malicious complaints to surrender policies and obtain commissions. Prosecutorial materials said 85 suspects were approved for arrest, exposing damage to insurer operations, consumer-service processes, and financial order, and showing how insurance commission, complaint-handling, and surrender workflows can be abused by organized groups.
